reviews.review_title: Review at Le Café Des Stagiaires - Saigon
reviews.review_text:
Globalb Nguyen
Pennsylvania1 contribution
1
The place has to be in your list to visit.
May 2026 • Friends
If you're looking for one of Saigon's most memorable nightlife destinations, Le Café des Stagiaires | Rooftop & Bistro is hard to beat.
Perched above the Saigon River, the rooftop delivers gorgeous panoramic views, especially at sunset when the skyline glows and Landmark 81 lights up across the water. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between relaxed and energetic, making it an ideal place to unwind with friends, enjoy cocktails, or simply soak in the cityscape.

As the weekend arrives, the venue transforms. Live DJs bring a vibrant beach vibes with carefully curated music that keeps the rooftop buzzing late into the night. Whether you're there for sunset drinks or dancing under the stars, the energy is infectious without feeling overwhelming.

Downstairs, the club and bistro host an impressive variety of events throughout the week—from live music and DJ nights to cultural gatherings, networking events, private parties, and community meetups. The mix of locals, expats, and travelers creates a welcoming atmosphere where it's easy to meet new people and enjoy a truly international vibe.

Add in quality European-inspired food, an excellent selection of Belgian beers, creative cocktails, attentive staff, and a riverside setting, and it's easy to see why Le Café des Stagiaires has become one of the city's favorite social destinations. Whether you're visiting Saigon for the first time or you're a local looking for a great night out, this is a venue that consistently delivers unforgettable sunsets, great music, and an atmosphere that keeps people coming back. Highly recommended.
